reasons.correctness: Port, properties (prefix currency.fixed-rates), adapter (case-insensitive, PLN=1) and toPln (HALF_UP, scale 2, BusinessRuleTranslatableException with the key and ISO argument) match the interface exactly. Build green, hidden tests 5/5.
reasons.convention_fit: Port in currency/port and adapter in currency/adapter. Explicit constructor injection. The new key is in both messages_en and messages_pl. MockitoExtension unit tests were run with -Ptest. Existing port, adapter, exception and properties files were read before writing new ones.
reasons.design_fit: The service depends only on ExchangeRatePort. Reuses BusinessRuleTranslatableException and the existing properties pattern. Small, cohesive footprint inside the currency feature package. The PLN entry in application.yml is redundant but harmless.
reasons.test_quality: Tests cover rounding, the half-up boundary, the missing-rate path (key and args checked), case-insensitivity, PLN and the unknown code. The PLN test never configures a conflicting PLN rate, so 'always 1' is not pinned. Null isoCode is untested.
reasons.graph_use: Three graph queries ran before any edit. They found the Port/Adapter examples (VatRegistryPort, BialaListaVatAdapter), the currency package files and the TranslatableException subclasses. The agent read those files and followed their structure.
